records.title: Baby Gender Reveal Cake

candidates.description:
A charming baby shower cake by Buzueva Cake features a smooth, two-toned finish in pastel pink and blue. The cake is decorated with matching fondant balls and button accents around its sides, creating a playful texture. Two miniature teddy bears perch on top, each seated on the pink or blue half, while a glittery topper poses the question “He? She?”. The words “GIRL” and “BOY” are spelled out in fondant on their corresponding sides, making this cake perfect for a gender reveal celebration.

This design is highlighted on a Pinterest page offering PAN India delivery and inviting viewers to place orders via direct message for more custom sweet treats.

A charming two-tier cake combines pastel pink and blue fondant to celebrate a baby shower gender reveal. The top tier is decorated with a cluster of fondant balloons in pink, blue, and gold, held by two adorable fondant teddy bears—one wearing a pink dress and the other a blue bow tie. White fondant clouds and tiny gold stars are scattered across both tiers, adding a whimsical sky theme. A large pastel blue bow wraps around the base, and a cloud-shaped plaque on the front reads “Boy? or Girl?” in glittery lettering, perfectly capturing the anticipation of the reveal.

This cake design, shared on Pinterest by Yanil Suardi under unique baby shower and gender reveal cake ideas, showcases expert fondant work and a playful color palette. It’s an ideal centerpiece for a celebration where guests await the big surprise of the baby’s gender.

A round white cake on a gold cake board features pastel pink and blue buttercream swirls along its top edge. Two fondant footprints—one pink, one blue—sit on either side of a twisted question mark, also in pink and blue, creating a playful gender reveal motif.

This cake’s smooth white frosting and colorful accents make it an ideal centerpiece for a baby shower or gender reveal party. The contrasting footprints and question mark invite guests to guess whether the new arrival will be a boy or a girl.

A pastel pink and blue cake designed for a gender reveal party features a striking gold question mark topper surrounded by clusters of spherical decorations. The two-tone frosting is split evenly, with “GIRL” in pink letters on the blue side and “BOY” in blue letters on the pink side, creating a playful contrast.

This cake’s textured finish and matching pastel spheres at the base and top enhance its festive appeal. Ideal for announcing a baby’s gender, the design balances whimsy and elegance, making it a memorable centerpiece for loved ones to share in the excitement.
